PatchTST official-source AMT forecasting adapter

Upstream: https://github.com/yuqinie98/PatchTST
Pinned commit: 204c21efe0b39603ad6e2ca640ef5896646ab1a9
Architecture: PatchTST_supervised/layers/PatchTST_backbone.py
License: Apache-2.0; LICENSE is included. UPSTREAM.json stores original and local hashes.
Only the two upstream internal import statements are changed to package-relative
imports, with an explicit modification notice. The official neural blocks remain
unchanged. adapter.py is our benchmark task wrapper, not official AMT code.

The official backbone independently models each channel and shares its encoder
and, by default, forecasting head across channels. It preserves author modules
including RevIN, learned patch positions, residual attention and BatchNorm.
This differs from the benchmark's joint-channel patch_transformer.

Frozen AMT task convention:
- Four channels, T=2048, known contiguous prefix, common missing suffix.
- Actual horizon h is inferred from observed_mask only, not a target array.
- Supply the most recent 1792 observed points to a fixed 256-step official head.
- Use the FIRST h head predictions and place them in the actual missing suffix.
- Mixed h values in a batch use a batched gather, without seven separate passes.
- Keep all observed points unchanged; evaluate reconstruction at missing points.
- Reject interior gaps, channel-dependent suffixes, horizons outside 1..256,
  and prefixes shorter than context_length. This adapter is forecasting-only.
- Hidden input values are removed before context extraction. The model never
  reads clean targets or loss masks. RevIN statistics use observed context only.

For h=10 the context is [246,2038); for h=256 it is [0,1792).
For shorter horizons, older visible history is intentionally omitted to retain
the author's fixed-size forecasting head. The existing full-window benchmark
models may use all 2048-h visible points. Disclose that context difference.
The shared maximum-horizon head and joint training across seven frozen horizons
are benchmark adaptations, not the author's per-horizon paper training protocol.
Do not claim official paper scores or untouched official experimental replication.

Performance considerations:
patch16/stride8/end gives 224 tokens for context1792; patch32/stride16/end gives112.
Author attention reshapes to batch*4; its explicit residual attention is not a
FlashAttention implementation. Real batch256 memory must be measured on the
target GPU; a tiny installation check does not validate full-size GPU capacity.
Record architecture, parameters, training budget, precision and peak memory.
